get.description: Inbox: jobs for the user's persona, ranked by fit (scored runs first), then low risk.

post.description:
Start (or return) the bid thread for a job. Never blocks on the graph.

Idempotent: one thread per user and job. If the marketplace is down the run stays `queued`
and is started automatically when it recovers.

200.description: SSE events: node, custom, interrupt, status, error, done. Auth via Bearer header or ?token= for EventSource.

get.description:
Pending approvals, read from checkpoint state so a refresh or API restart loses nothing.

The runs table status can lag a crash (it may still say `running`), so every candidate is
confirmed against the checkpoint.

post.description: Resume the interrupted thread with approve, edit (text) or reject (reason).

Regenerate one paragraph of the pending draft.

TODO(graph lane): the bid graph has no single paragraph rewrite entry point yet. This adapter
validates ownership and the paragraph index, then reports regenerated=false so the UI can show
the message. Wire it to a writer rewrite function when agent/nodes/writer.py exposes one.

get.description:
Kanban from checkpoint state plus marketplace events (a client message means `replied`).

Works while the marketplace is down (cards just stop advancing), so the board never errors.

post.description: Suggest a reply to the latest client message. Nothing is sent: sending needs approval.

get.description: Promoted memory only (style and outcome), scoped to the calling user.

put.description: Autonomy can auto-skip low fit jobs but never auto-sends (enforced in the graph, not here).

get.description:
Public. `marketplace: down` puts the UI in degraded mode. When it is up again, runs that
were queued during the outage are started.
